items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: When Dr. King did his speech in sixty— you didn’t see that.

ctx.x: It drives me nuts too. And I guess sometimes people say well it’s all about as long as they get the conservative judges they want or something, but that seems like a poor excuse to me.

It’s a real poor excuse and young people see that phoniness and they don’t want to have any part of it. And that’s the thing, it really bothers me. If something gets me angry, that gets me angry more than anything else. And now we don’t know how the election is going to turn out. I’m going to go vote early, and I’m going to do my little two cents, because that’s all you can do. But you know what I try to do my classes and we talk about it and I say, “You guys go out and vote.” See the last time the young people…
